stem: Which political button reflects the connection between the Vietnam War and the passage of the Twenty-Sixth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution?

options.label: A
options.text: Old enough to fight, Old enough to vote!

options.label: B
options.text: Soldiers, defend your ability to protest!

options.label: D
options.text: Money can't buy your way out of the draft!
